title: Supreme Court Gets Five New Judges as President Approves Appointments
text:
Press Release Page | Press Information Bureau

Ministry of Law and Justice

Supreme Court Gets Five New Judges as President Approves Appointments

Posted On:
01 JUN 2026 9:31AM by PIB Delhi

Vide Notifications of even number dated 01.06.2026, in exercise of the powers conferred by clause (2) of Article 124 of the Constitution of India, the Hon’ble President of India is pleased to appoint (i) Shri Justice Sheel Nagu, Chief Justice, High Court of Punjab and Haryana, (ii) Shri Justice Shree Chandrashekhar, Chief Justice, High Court of Bombay, (iii) Shri Justice Sanjeev Sachdeva, Chief Justice, High Court of Madhya Pradesh, (iv) Shri Justice Arun Palli, Chief Justice, High Court of Jammu & Kashmir and Ladakh and (v) Smt. Venkita Subramani Mohana, Senior advocate, to be Judges of the Supreme Court of India with effect from the date they assume charge of their office.



(Jagannath Srinivasan)

Joint Secretary to the Government of India
